thread:
maya: Quick async Q3 OKR milestone check-in — keeping this short. Please respond only if you own an item or need to flag a dependency. TL;DR below, details in replies.

maya: TL;DR — shipped: model-routing canary, token-billing UI. slipped: Dedicated auto-scale policy v1 (infra blocker). in flight: evals infra for regression alerts. Owners listed per line.

ethan: Shipped ✅ model-routing canary is live in us-west, perf looks good. Noted a few edge cases with long-prefix caching that I logged as followups. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/model-routing/pull/418 (merge in staging).

rachel: Token-billing UI shipped to beta orgs. Need a docs pass (I can take it). Posted screenshots in #docs. No blockers.

samir: Dedicated autoscale v1 slipped — hit a kube autoscaler bug during soak. ETA +2 weeks unless we accept a fallback: manual scale ops (oncall rotate). I recommend we downgrade rollout to delayed canary and move the SLA target. @maya @ethan fyi.

alex: Dependency note: OpenTelemetry upgrade is required for the autoscale fix (breaking change for metric names). I can own the upgrade but will need 3 days of bench testing. Marks as blocker for samir's change.

maya: Proposal: prioritize short-term rollback/fallback path for Dedicated (manual scale ops) so customers don't hit throttling, and schedule autoscale v1 for next sprint after OTEL upgrade. Approve? :thumbsup: for fallback, :thumbsdown: to push harder.

ethan: +1 for fallback. We can ship a scripted runbook and an alert to page the infra responder. I can wire the alert in a couple hours.

rachel: +1 — avoids customer impact. I'll update the release notes to reflect the postponed autoscale.

samir: Agree with fallback. I'll open a short-lived runbook and add the autoscale PR to a gated list with the OTEL dependency. PR: `https://git.internal/r/redwood/dedicated-autoscale/pull/55`

alex: I'll start the OTEL upgrade branch today and drop a status note in a few hours. ETA for bench tests: 72h.

ethan: One more item: Evals infra is in flight. We have the baseline runner ready but need canonical prompt sets from Product for the top 5 model families. @maya can you confirm owners?

maya: Owners for evals prompt sets: Product — rachel (lead), Eng-ML — samir (coord). Rachel, can you collect the sets by EOD Tue? If not, callout now.

rachel: I can compile initial prompt sets by Tue EOD. Will ping product PMs for edge-cases.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: model-routing-canary succeeded on 9 hosts; 0 failures.

ethan: Final ask — if you own any blocked item, please add a 1-line update here by EOD today. I'll aggregate into the weekly OKR slack summary. Thanks all! :rocket:
